definitions.explanation: Medicine sprayed or dropped into the nose, for example for a blocked nose or hay fever.

examples.japanese: {点鼻薬|てんびやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{点鼻薬|てんびやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手放|てばな}せない→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧。
examples.english: In hay-fever season I can't do without my nasal spray.

examples.japanese: {点鼻薬|てんびやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、かえって⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まり→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: Overusing a nasal spray can actually make your nose more prone to blocking up.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (to apply drop by drop) + {鼻|び} (nose) + {薬|やく} (medicine). Compare ⟦{点眼薬|てんがんやく}→点眼薬：24269_tenganyaku⟧ (eye drops, in everyday speech ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {点鼻薬|てんびやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さす: to use nose drops
- {点鼻薬|てんびやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a nasal spray
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点鼻薬|てんびやく}: an over-the-counter nasal spray
